From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-22T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request + credits (CloudCorp) — exec approval request

Folks — forwarding CloudCorp request (thread below). Ask: can we approve a one-month pilot + $20k trial credit as an exception?

Context / rationale:
- Account: CloudCorp (large enterprise platform team; strategic reference potential across EMEA later this year).
- Timing: procurement needs written confirmation before 2026-09-10 to include in their Q3 buys.
- Upside: expected ARR if pilot converts ~ $600k ARR over 12 months; low CAC, high visibility.
- Ask details: 1 month pilot (no charge) + $20,000 usage credit to cover ramp. No discount to list pricing requested, but procurement asked if we could combine with a small introductory discount to shorten procurement cycle.

Proposed commercial package for quick approval (recommended by me):
- One-month pilot at $0 for up to 1 pilot workspace (baseline).
- Bridge credit: $18,000 applied to usage over the pilot period (not refundable).
- Introductory commercial: 25% discount on first-year invoice if they execute a 12-month commitment within 90 days of pilot close.

Why this makes sense: reduces friction for procurement, keeps credits modest vs. ask, and ties discount to a fast conversion (limits downside).

Operational asks if we approve:
- Legal to draft a one-paragraph amendment + DocuSign.
- Finance to reserve $18k in credits on the deal record (HUB-4529-CC) and confirm billing flow.

I’m happy to jump on a quick call to walk through.

Thanks,
—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Sean / Vivek —

Thanks for the clear ask and rationale. I approve an exception with the following binding limits:

1) Approve a one-month pilot at no charge.
2) Approve bridge credit, capped at $18,000 (apply to usage during pilot).
3) Approve a contingent 25% introductory discount for a signed 12-month contract if executed within 90 days of pilot end.

Operational notes:
- Legal: please prepare a short amendment confirming the pilot and credit details. Keep language to a single paragraph referencing deal id HUB-4529-CC and include standard audit/logging/data usage clauses.
- Finance: create a credit memo line item for $18,000 and ensure it is consumed only against pilot usage. No refunds.
- Sales: Sean, include the conditional discount clause in the commercial summary; do not promise anything beyond the limits above.

If procurement needs a signature, I’m fine signing a one-off letter on company letterhead. Send the DocuSign to marissa_cole@redwood.ai and cc legal.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
